structured_output.what_is_happening: This is a 13-minute-old "Cream" token on pumpswap, launched through a Meteora virtual curve that migrated right away. Its GeckoTerminal X link is a status post by cremieuxrecueil, which is likely the X personality Cremieux, and its website is a usepaid.app link. At least 10 other "Cream" tokens were deployed within about 17 minutes, so something is setting off a burst of clone launches. This one is about 2nd–3rd by market cap ($254k). One Cream is at $533k and another has $1.06M of hourly volume. Price is up about 350% since launch. In the last hour it had 457 unique buyers against 80 unique sellers, and turnover is about 9x market cap per hour.

narrative.description: This looks like a tweet-driven ticker rush: many coins named 'Cream' tied to one X post, probably from Cremieux. It is a one-word meme rush with no project behind it.
narrative.why_spreading: A viral or high-follower X post set off multiple launches. Traders are spreading their bets across the clones while they wait for attention to settle on one winner.

token_connection.why_this_token: It links to the source tweet and has the 2nd-highest market cap among the Cream clones, with strong buyer breadth.
token_connection.competing_tokens: There are at least 10 same-name tokens. 66Rv… is at $533k market cap and was created earlier. Do4VN… was created first and has $1.06M in hourly volume. 6riG… and DdGE… were also created earlier. FxKB… has $638k in hourly volume.

authenticity.evidence: Buyer breadth looks real: 457 unique buyers against 80 sellers, and 238 buyers in the last 5 minutes. But GMGN flags 51 bundler wallets holding about 11.8% as top traders. The usepaid.app link points to a paid launch service. No paid DexScreener boosts are shown, and there are no smart-money or KOL wallets.
authenticity.uncertainty: There is no X data, so I can't confirm the tweet's reach or whether it names or endorses any specific contract.

structural_risks: RugCheck flags 99.99% of the LP as unlocked (GMGN reports the LP as burned, so the sources conflict)
One unlabeled holder has 80%, probably a curve or pool account, but this is not confirmed
More than 10 clones splitting the same attention
Liquidity is $41k against a $254k market cap, and the creator has closed their position

structured_output.counterargument: Tweet-driven rushes can pick a winner quickly. This coin has the tweet link, a high share of buyers, and the momentum of the 2nd-largest clone, so it could flip the $533k leader and go well past 2x in minutes. If the 80% holder is the curve pool and the LP really is burned, as GMGN says, the structure is cleaner than RugCheck makes it look.

structured_output.thesis: This is a real attention spike, but it is spread across more than 10 clones, and this coin is not the first or the leader. It has already run about 3.5x, and the 5-minute volume is slowing compared with the peak. In clone rushes, most clones bleed out once one winner emerges. Buyer breadth keeps it slightly above the base rate, but the 4-minute entry after a 350% run makes a -50% hit more likely than a +100%.
